## Featured Projects
1. **Tessera (AI Repository Intelligence Platform)**
   - Description: AI-assisted GitHub repository analyzer helping developers understand unfamiliar codebases through evidence-grounded AI insights, architecture visualization, and code auditing.
   - Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, FastAPI, Python, Supabase, Gemini
   - GitHub: https://github.com/itsvoidstack/tessera
   - Live Demo: https://tesseraa-app.netlify.app

2. **Chroniqx (Media Tracking Platform)**
   - Description: Full-stack media tracking platform with real-time activity, automated media tracking, and personalized libraries.
   - Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, APIs, Vercel
   - GitHub: https://github.com/itsvoidstack/chroniq
   - Live Demo: https://chroniqx.vercel.app

3. **ResQ-Nepal (SOS & Emergency Platform)**
   - Description: Civic emergency platform connecting users with emergency services, community support, and essential resources.
   - Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, APIs, Vercel
   - GitHub: https://github.com/itsvoidstack/ResQ-Nepal

4. **connect-grow (Multi-Role Collaboration Platform)**
   - Description: Multi-role platform concept connecting businesses, workers, mentors, and students through role-based experiences.
   - Stack: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Tailwind CSS
   - GitHub: https://github.com/itsvoidstack/connect-grow
